name: DeanGo HANDS (Hermes brain)
description: First-class Hermes Agent backend for OpenClaw. Hermes is the body+brain (turn loop, memory, skills, learning); OpenClaw remains the nerves+limbs (channels, devices, approvals, artifacts). Spinal cord: ACP v1 over stdio.

sessionResume.description: Reattach existing Hermes sessions across gateway restarts (the body outlives the spine).

provenance.description: Pass OpenClaw session/surface metadata into Hermes as ACP _meta so the brain knows which leg it is speaking through.

mcpServers.description: ACP-level MCP servers (the hands) injected into every Hermes session. Stable across OpenClaw updates because injection is an ACP v1 feature, not an OpenClaw internal.

command.label: Brain command
command.help: Command that starts the Hermes ACP agent (stdio). Use DeanGo's launcher for stdio hygiene (deango connect renders it).

sessionResume.label: Session resume
sessionResume.help: Keeps the organism's memory continuous: reattach Hermes bodies after restarts/updates instead of starting blank.

provenance.label: Leg provenance
provenance.help: Tells the brain which surface (whatsapp/telegram/ui…) and pairing identity each prompt walked in on.

mcpServers.label: Hands (MCP servers)
mcpServers.help: Tools the brain may call mid-turn — OpenClaw core/plugin tools, exposed over MCP.
